method: Complete reads of pinned cautions and FAQ; verified Git blob and SHA256. Documentation claims distinguished from executed evidence.
findings: Count comparisons require matching hidden-file, hardlink, symlink and directory-merge policies; FAQ recommends paranoid comparison and raw file counts.
Replay assumes unchanged filesystem; cached checksums and newer-than filters do not establish final content equality.

Cautions discuss historical hash collision probabilities, other-tool bugs and benchmark timings; none establish current correctness or performance of those tools. No linked malicious fixtures or mutation commands executed.
Path identity and cycle discussion agrees with device/inode and parent-identity controls, but documentation is not an executed traversal proof.
FAQ estimates approximately150 bytes per file plus path storage, and cites five-million-file experience. This is neither a strict RAM bound nor a current measurement.
FAQ excludes similarity search and a Windows port from its requested scope; separately reviewed Cygwin smoke workflow limits any blanket unsupported-platform inference.
Hardlink/reflink replacement and kernel checks described here remain platform-dependent and were not executed.
limits: No current platform or performance qualification from historical documentation.
